default_vs_upstream: Upstream periods/windows; separately graded stage where specified; public physical-output adapter.
variant: Advance every nonzero component of each assigned u_cmd by two binary64 ULPs toward positive infinity. The public deck supplies the nominal values; no RNG or production helper chooses the perturbation.
altbuild: none: a second source build would duplicate the initial low-memory build; this package calibrates nominal and perturbed inputs and reports no cross-compiler floor.

evidence.floor_how: No declared CLI altbuild or GPU floor. Supplementary existing native/compiler comparisons have zero pointwise differences; see comment/calibration-evidence.json.

warrant: Pointwise physical values detect incorrect torque, speed or power limiting; the per-array rule is abs(error) <= atol + rtol*abs(reference), in the listed SI units. The human finalized these scientific bounds after calibration. Native nominal/variant worst bound fraction was 2.71e-11; 4 output-corruption/permutation trials behaved as specified (see comment/native-validation.json). These trials test outputs, not source mutations. Wheel identities and rotation matrices remove storage and MRP conventions. Container worst bound fraction: 2.71048e-11. No GPU or alternative-build floor is measured.
knobs: none: the official component check is a single algebraic torque request; no time window exists.
